params.body:
Decode read 5,000 a day and Intelligence 20,000 a day per key. Both now read **2,000 a day per key**. A team plan holds four keys, so Intelligence is 8,000 for the account.

Why:
- The busiest reader so far did 22 reads in a day, so 5,000 and 20,000 were numbers nobody reaches. They read as a selling point.
- They also promised more than the brake on sources lets through: a member can open the sources of a limited number of distinct trends a day. The site side widens that brake per plan in a separate PR.
- What separates the plans is what they open, and the pricing table now says that.

Explore (50) and Signal (500) are unchanged. These are the defaults. Production has no saved override (`store/plans.json` is absent), so this is what the site will show. An admin can still change them on the Settings page.

Tests: full suite 957 passing.
params.title: Plans: Decode and Intelligence read 2,000 a day per key
